tasks.short: Analyze research measurements of physical phenomena

steps.what: Inspect actual research data provenance, instrument calibration, sampling and physical measurement definitions
inputs: actual instrument/research measurements and metadata
actual experiment protocol and calibration records

steps.what: Choose defensible physical/statistical analysis methods, uncertainty propagation and exclusion criteria
inputs: physicist-checked measurement dataset and limitations
actual physical hypothesis and research question

steps.what: Analyze the actual research measurements using the selected method and inspect residuals, uncertainties and sensitivity
inputs: physicist-checked measurement dataset and limitations
physicist's specified measurement-analysis method
outputs: actual physical-phenomena analysis results and uncertainty checks

steps.what: Interpret the measured physical phenomena and complete the checked analysis notebook with evidence limits
inputs: actual physical-phenomena analysis results and uncertainty checks
outputs: complete checked physical measurement analysis notebook

steps.what: Save the completed checked physical measurement analysis notebook
inputs: complete checked physical measurement analysis notebook

tasks.design: Configure native rerunnable analysis profiles in {OTHER}, the scientific analysis/notebook application, for the physicist's selected method. The physicist checks actual measurements, chooses assumptions and inspects physical/statistical validity before completing and saving the notebook; existing numerical execution earns no new saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated human analysis setup can consume effort even when numerical tools already execute calculations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native profiles can reuse a selected analysis configuration with explicit inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Instrument effects and uncertainty can mimic the phenomenon under study.
tasks.human_edge: Reject a convincing result that depends on an unjustified exclusion or calibration assumption.

ambition.what: No automatic physical discovery or finding.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native rerunnable scientific profiles can reduce repeated setup while measurement validity and physical interpretation require expert judgment.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human analysis effort, not runtime, measured baselines or prompt priors.

Instruments/research staff supply actual measurements, units, timestamps, run identity and calibration records. The physicist checks and manually resolves missing metadata in s1/s3; no complete input contract is assumed free.
Only repeated profile setup changes. Existing equivalent profiles remove the gain; all method selection, analysis inspection and interpretation remain counted.
Gross provisional saving 4.5 minus 1.5 hours of profile validation/upkeep gives 3 net. The negligible save is fully retained.
Do not add overlapping complex-calculation or mathematical-description work again to this analysis in a roll-up.
unknowns: Actual repeated setup and current profile coverage
research_questions: Does profile reuse save human work after complete measurement and result validation?

already_counted.description: Inspect selected analysis outputs and complete/check interpretation

approvals.approved_version: complete checked physical measurement analysis notebook

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 3%; substantive physical analysis remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Report experiments through journal papers or conference presentations

steps.what: Select actual experimental results, uncertainty statements, figures and references for the scientific report
inputs: actual validated experimental analysis and figures
actual research question, source literature and journal requirements

steps.what: Write the scientific journal paper's experimental results and explanatory narrative from actual evidence
inputs: physicist-checked experimental reporting evidence pack
actual intended paper argument and journal structure
outputs: draft scientific paper with source-linked claims

loop.purpose: Propose explanatory prose for actual experimental results
loop.input: checked experimental evidence pack and physicist's paper argument
loop.output: draft prose with exact result/figure/source references and explicit gaps
loop.check: Physicist checks every scientific claim, number, uncertainty and citation against actual evidence
loop.stop: Unsupported result, invented reference or altered uncertainty returns to manual authoring
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed templates handle figure/table fields but cannot express the specific experimental argument

steps.what: Complete and check the final paper, figures, scientific claims, author permissions and intended journal recipient
inputs: draft scientific paper with source-linked claims
physicist-checked experimental reporting evidence pack
actual coauthor permissions for the final manuscript
outputs: complete checked authorised final manuscript and journal recipient

steps.what: Submit the completed checked authorised final manuscript to the intended scientific journal
inputs: complete checked authorised final manuscript and journal recipient

tasks.design: Use native figure/table and reference fields in {DOCS} before a bounded evidence-pack prose draft. The physicist verifies every claim and obtains actual final-version author permissions before the separate {PARTNER_PORTAL} journal submission; conference delivery remains live expert presentation rather than generated speech.
tasks.previous_blocker: Explaining experimental results in a coherent paper takes prose work beyond fixed figure/reference fields.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can propose prose tied to actual validated results.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible narrative can overstate a result or conceal uncertainty.
tasks.human_edge: State exactly what the experiment supports and what remains unresolved.

ambition.what: No automatic publication or scientific-quality claim.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-7 for unpublished research processing and author consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded source-grounded prose can assist scientific reporting while all experimental claims and publication permissions require human verification.

assumptions: Shares describe an unmeasured journal-paper reporting route permitted by the task's alternative wording, not a conference baseline.

Research staff supply actual validated analysis/figures; publishers supply actual references; coauthors supply real permissions. Physicist collection, claim selection and permission checking remain in s1/s3; other authors' review effort is not credited as a saving.
Native formatting/references first. The loop cannot invent data, sources, author assent or conclusions; source capture and all verification are counted.
Gross provisional saving 8 minus 2 hours of draft-rule/source upkeep gives 6 net. The negligible final submission is fully retained.

Only the actual final manuscript with required author permission may be submitted; edits invalidate the gate. Conference-only work retains its actual presentation/Q&A time and needs separate measurement.
unknowns: Net prose effort after scientific verification and actual author process
research_questions: Does source-grounded drafting save real manuscript effort after full scientific checking?

already_counted.description: Inspect prose and complete/check authorised scientific manuscript

incremental.description: Maintain evidence-pack drafting rules and inspect unsupported-claim failures

approvals.approved_version: complete checked authorised final manuscript and journal recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 6%; all scientific claim checking and final author permissions remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform complex computer calculations for data evaluation

steps.what: Specify the complex calculation, physical equations, numerical precision, units and intended data evaluation
inputs: actual data-evaluation question and physical model
actual numerical inputs and definitions
outputs: physicist's specified calculation and numerical checks

steps.what: Implement and execute complex calculations using the computer's native scientific numerical routines
inputs: physicist's specified calculation and numerical checks
actual numerical inputs with units and provenance

steps.what: Validate numerical stability, limiting cases and physical meaning and complete the checked calculation notebook
inputs: actual computed results and implementation
physicist's specified calculation and numerical checks

steps.what: Save the completed checked complex-calculation notebook
inputs: complete checked complex-calculation notebook

tasks.design: Configure native reusable numerical profiles in {OTHER}, the scientific computing application, for the physicist's specified equations. The physicist checks actual inputs, numerical stability and physical limits before completing and saving the notebook; existing computer arithmetic and unattended runtime earn no new saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated human numerical setup can remain even with established computer routines.
tasks.enabler_now: Native profiles can reuse checked routine/parameter structure.
tasks.still_hard: Numerical convergence does not establish a valid physical result.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a stable-looking result that violates a physical limit or dimensional constraint.

ambition.what: No automatic equation choice or physical conclusion.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for numerical data and application configuration access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native numerical profiles can reduce repeated human setup while equations and numerical/physical validity require expert checks.

assumptions: Shares describe provisional human calculation effort, not a measured baseline or runtime.
Research owners supply actual inputs and definitions; the physicist selects and checks equations/units in s1/s2. Missing parameters require manual investigation.
Only repeated routine setup changes; new derivation, implementation validity and all checking remain counted. Equivalent current profiles remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 3.5 minus 1 hour of profile validation/upkeep gives 2.5 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
This calculation may be part of the broader analysis task and must not be added again in a role total.
research_questions: Which actual human calculation steps remain repetitive after current numerical software?

already_counted.description: Inspect calculation implementation and validate physical/numerical outputs

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 2.5%; equation choice and numerical/physical validation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Express physical observations and conclusions mathematically

steps.what: Examine actual physical observations and conclusions and define quantities, units and mathematical assumptions
inputs: actual observations and physical conclusions
actual variable definitions and uncertainty limits

steps.what: Describe and express actual observations and conclusions as mathematical relationships and derivations
inputs: physicist's mathematical quantities and assumptions
actual physical observations and conclusions

steps.what: Enter, typeset and check the actual mathematical notation, definitions and limits in the research document
inputs: physicist's derived mathematical description
outputs: complete checked mathematical description of observations/conclusions

steps.what: Save the completed checked mathematical description of observations/conclusions
inputs: complete checked mathematical description of observations/conclusions

tasks.design: Configure native reusable notation macros in {DOCS} and {OTHER}, the equation editor, for the physicist's actual mathematical description. The physicist defines and derives the relationships, enters/checks their meaning and notation, then saves; no model generates or validates a physical derivation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated notation entry and formatting can interrupt mathematical expression.
tasks.enabler_now: Native notation macros can reuse fixed symbols and expression styles.
tasks.still_hard: Correct notation can still describe an invalid physical inference.
tasks.human_edge: Choose assumptions and relationships that faithfully express the actual observation.

ambition.what: No automatic mathematical discovery or proof.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for research document and notation configuration access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native notation macros can reduce repeated expression formatting while mathematical meaning and derivation remain expert work.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human mathematical-description effort, not a measured baseline.

Actual experiment/research records supply observations; the physicist supplies definitions and derived expressions in s1/s2 and enters/checks them in s3. No pre-existing structured equation specification is assumed free.
Only repeated notation handling changes. Existing equivalent macros remove the gain; all substantive derivation and semantic checks remain retained.
Gross provisional saving 1.9 minus 0.5 hour of notation-macro upkeep gives 1.4 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
This expression work may overlap analysis or paper writing and must not be added again in a role total.
research_questions: Does macro reuse reduce real notation work after full expression checking?

already_counted.description: Enter and check the mathematical description

incremental.description: Maintain notation macros and symbol definitions

approvals.approved_version: complete checked mathematical description of observations/conclusions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1.4%; all mathematical reasoning and semantic validation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Verify scientific prose against experimental evidence
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated scientific setup and prose handling while retaining physical interpretation, mathematical reasoning and publication responsibility.
